stopping_policy: maximum 10 motifs; STREME significance threshold 0.05; report MEME E-values without equating them to p-values
background_A: one dinucleotide-preserving shuffle per training primary; input file suffix _N1.fasta
background_B: same-species other-sigma matched without replacement in 0.05 GC strata; use _other_matched_primary.fasta as the paired primary
other_sigma_exclusion: any target sigma annotation in any member of a control homology cluster
meme_model: zoops; explicit control comparison via fixed-PWM scans rather than substituting Markov backgrounds for negative samples
search_strands: both; genomic strand and motif hit strand stored separately
external_holdout: never used in discovery, parameter selection, or threshold selection; no rediscovery on holdout
candidate_output: separate from strict site-q output; never calculate q from only a p-truncated table
references: empirical experimental sites with alignment, sample counts, pseudocounts and overlap provenance; old consensus templates are exploratory
BH_and_grammar_analysis_plan_status: pending_before_scanning; freeze hypothesis families, pair selection and bootstrap units
toolchain_status: local MEME Suite not runnable; Docker/WSL distribution not available
